name: North Dakota
overview: North Dakota combines a broad primary-residence credit with income-tested senior and disability relief for owners and renters.

programs.name: Primary Residence Credit
programs.maximumBenefit: Up to $1,600 against property tax due for tax year 2025.
programs.formulaSummary: Approved primary residences receive a credit limited by remaining property tax liability.
programs.application: Annual online application to the Office of State Tax Commissioner.
eligibilityNotes: One credit per household; owner must occupy the home as the primary residence.
interactions: Applied after Homestead or Disabled Veterans credits to any remaining property tax balance.
programs.programYear: 2025 property-tax year; the credit appears on the property-tax statement.

sources.title: Primary Residence Application History: 2025 retroactive increase

programs.name: Homestead Property Tax Credit
programs.ageRule: 65 or older, or permanently and totally disabled.
programs.incomeDefinition: Applicant, spouse and dependents' income, with specified medical-expense deductions; preceding calendar year.
programs.maximumBenefit: Reduces taxable value by up to $9,000, equivalent to $200,000 true and full value.
programs.formulaSummary: Income through $40,000 receives 100% of eligible value reduction; $40,001–$70,000 receives 50%. Tax savings depend on local rates.
programs.application: Apply to local assessor or county director of tax equalization.
eligibilityNotes: Must live in and hold an interest in the homestead.
interactions: Primary Residence Credit may offset remaining taxes.
programs.programYear: 2025 assessment year, using 2024 household income; applications precede March 31 of the assessment year.

sources.title: Homestead Property Tax Credit and Renter's Refund

programs.name: Renter's Refund
programs.ageRule: 65 or older, or permanently and totally disabled.
programs.incomeDefinition: Applicant, spouse and dependents' income after permitted deductions.
programs.formulaSummary: Refunds the amount by which 20% of eligible annual rent exceeds 4% of annual income, capped at $600.
programs.application: Apply to Tax Commissioner by May 31 following the rent year.
eligibilityNotes: Generally unavailable for tax-exempt rental property; payments in lieu of taxes can qualify.
interactions: Claimants generally cannot claim both the homeowner homestead credit and renter refund, except for qualifying mobile-home lot rent.
programs.programYear: 2025 rent and income; the refund claim follows in 2026.
